laws.rule: Nkhotakota Wildlife Reserve: the published protected-area regulations bar entry after 16:00 and before 06:00 unless the Chief Parks and Wildlife Officer or Wildlife Officer gives written permission. The section of the M10 (Mbobo-Wozi) inside the reserve is also closed to vehicle driving from 18:00 to 06:00 under that exception.
